measurements.note: Flagged as physically implausible: the sheet prints a tensile modulus of 1400 MPa for a product its title rates 90A and whose elongation at break it gives as above 300 %; Gent's relation puts a 90 Shore A elastomer near 21 MPa. Its flexural modulus, flexural strength, break strength, glass transition and heat deflection are a rigid plastic's too, and the sheet prints no other table. Kept as printed; it backs nothing.
